sections.en: v. 2 ff. In the margin by the same hand but in red ink: If at the hour of the bedriding the Moon and the ascendant are surrounded by malefics, with none of the benefics having a relation to the Moon and the ascendant, the sign is deadly. And the malefics make things incurable, having alone taken the mastery of the configurations. 3 τε] δὲ codex, corrected by Kroll. 5 ὁλοκλήρωσις is said for ὁλοκληρία in similarity to the word κλήρωσις.

summary.headline: Serapion on Runaways and Confinements
summary.text: Astrological rules for judging a ruler’s downfall, followed by Serapion’s chapters on runaways and on confinements or bedridings. The text interprets the Moon, ascendant, malefics, benefics, nodes, signs, inceptions, and planetary afflictions.
